result.stdout:
strawhats — Strawhats.Framework CLI

Usage:
  strawhats feature add <Name> [options]                      Domain → Business → Persistence → Api slice
  strawhats valueobject add <Name> [options]                  a Domain ValueObject
  strawhats specification add <Name> --for=<Aggregate> [...]  a Specification<TAggregate> (Business)
  strawhats handler add <Event> --for=<Aggregate> [...]       an INotificationHandler for a domain event
  strawhats route list [--root=<dir>]                          list the Api project's HTTP routes

Generates files only and leaves `// TODO (strawhats)` wiring markers; it never edits existing
files or runs migrations. Layer projects are detected via the nearest .slnx.

Options:
  --for=<Aggregate>  (specification, handler) the aggregate the type belongs to.
  --no-query         (feature) skip the query side (Get<Name>ById + its endpoint).
  --no-api           (feature) skip the Api layer (endpoints + request contract).
  --result-pattern   (feature) emit Result<>+errors+ToHttpResult (needs a ToHttpResult host).
  --dry-run          show what would be generated without writing any files.
  --force            overwrite existing files.
  --root=<dir>       solution root to generate into (default: current directory).
  -h, --help         show this help.

Examples:
  strawhats feature add Order
  strawhats valueobject add Money
  strawhats specification add ActiveOrders --for=Order
  strawhats handler add OrderCreated --for=Order
